source.label: RoboDojo · frozen evaluation and public leaderboard

rows.label: 整理桌面
rows.initial: 鼠标、键盘、摆件、闹钟和杂物散布在桌面。
rows.goal: 将指定物品放到各自位置，再打开抽屉收纳剩余杂物，最后归位双臂。

rows.label: 按语言分类
rows.initial: 多个类别的物体混放，篮子的对应关系由当前指令给出。
rows.goal: 按照本条指令的类别—篮子映射放置全部物体，最后归位双臂。

rows.label: 模仿排序顺序
rows.initial: 场景先提供一段物体排序示范。
rows.goal: 先观察并记住示范，再按照相同顺序放置相应物体，最后归位双臂。

rows.label: 排出最大数字
rows.initial: 数字块散落在目标垫附近。
rows.goal: 从左到右组成最大的数字，校正朝向并放在目标垫上，最后归位双臂。

rows.label: 装箱
rows.initial: 多个不同形状的物体分布在箱子周围。
rows.goal: 将所有物体装进箱中，并满足指令要求的朝向，最后归位双臂。

rows.label: 物体分类
rows.initial: 多种物体与三个分类篮摆在桌面上。
rows.goal: 把全部物体按类别分入三个篮子，最后归位双臂。

rows.label: 搭塔
rows.initial: 木块与木板尚未组成塔。
rows.goal: 按要求搭建有支撑的层叠结构，并在归位双臂后保持稳定。

rows.label: 麻将杠牌
rows.initial: 手牌与弃牌区域已布置，等待任务中的弃牌。
rows.goal: 亮出匹配的牌并完成规定的杠牌操作序列，不扰动其他牌；此任务不是以双臂归位判定完成。

rows.label: 叠衣服
rows.initial: 衣服在桌面展开，袖子和下摆尚未折叠。
rows.goal: 向内折袖子，再向上折下摆，形成符合要求的折叠形状，最后归位双臂。

rows.label: 瓶子入桶
rows.initial: 桌面散放多个瓶子，旁边有垃圾桶。
rows.goal: 将所有瓶子放入垃圾桶，并归位双臂。

rows.instruction: Fold the clothes neatly.
Observe the object placement order, remember it, then place the corresponding objects into the basket in the same order.
rows.title: 先拨动，再抓取
rows.analysis: GPT 不局限于直接夹取：先通过接触改变物体状态，再继续抓取。局部恢复不等于整个任务一定成功。

rows.instruction: Observe the object placement order, remember it, then place the corresponding objects into the basket in the same order.
Observe the object placement order, remember it, then place the corresponding objects into the basket in the same order.
rows.title: 困难状态下调整抓取
rows.analysis: 展示在物体和夹爪的相对关系不理想时，主动调整接近方式。是否最终成功以该条原生结果为准。

rows.instruction: Place all the objects into the box with their front sides facing left.
rows.title: 检查箱子后面的遗漏
rows.analysis: 根据你的标注，策略在收尾阶段发现并尝试处理箱后物体及其朝向。该条最终未成功，因此这里只展示恢复尝试。

rows.instruction: Sort the objects by category into the three baskets.

Place the mouse on the mouse pad, push the keyboard into the frame, put the figurine on the stand, place the alarm clock on the drawer, then open the drawer and put all remaining miscellaneous items inside.
Arrange the numbers from left to right to form the largest possible number, and place them on the pad.
Arrange the numbers from left to right to form the largest possible number, and place them on the pad.
rows.title: 控制遇到困难后，仍能尝试恢复
rows.analysis: 数字摆放中的恢复片段展示了对控制反馈的适应。GPT 已收到本体状态；困难在于能否有效利用这些信息，而不是没有输入。

rows.instruction: Arrange the numbers from left to right to form the largest possible number, and place them on the pad.
rows.title: 历史片段：重新定位数字块
rows.analysis: 保留 v2 的代表性 grounding 片段，仅用于解释行为，不计入本文 v3 的成绩。

rows.instruction: Build a tower using the wooden blocks and wooden boards.
rows.title: 动作可执行，不一定足够稳健
rows.analysis: 没有候选动作作为参考时，GPT-only 可以提出不同的搭塔方式，但局部可执行与结构稳定并不等价。

rows.instruction: Build a tower using the wooden blocks and wooden boards.
rows.title: 动作段内部，反馈可能来得太晚
rows.analysis: 策略在 chunk 边界观察；执行中的滑落或碰撞可能要到下一次反馈才被发现。此片段提示反馈粒度的限制，并非缺少整段原始录像。

rows.instruction: Place the mouse on the mouse pad, push the keyboard into the frame, put the figurine on the stand, place the alarm clock on the drawer, then open the drawer and put all remaining miscellaneous items inside.
rows.title: 单臂还是双臂，也是一种策略选择
rows.analysis: 你的标注指出，这段整理桌面的单臂操作不够稳定。它提示动作先验可能有帮助，但目前没有专门的因果消融。

rows.instruction: Build a tower using the wooden blocks and wooden boards.
Pick up the bottles and throw them into the dustbin, using handover when needed.
rows.title: 没有 π0.5：尝试把瓶子扫进桶
rows.analysis: GPT-only 自行选择了非典型的扫落方案。动作有新意，但这条最终失败，不能把有趣的行为等同于有效控制。

rows.instruction: Wait for the opponent to discard a tile, then declare a kong with the matching tiles.
Observe the object placement order, remember it, then place the corresponding objects into the basket in the same order.
rows.title: 理解目标，不代表留足净空
rows.analysis: 容器边缘与夹爪、物体之间的碰撞会使搬运失败。知道该放到哪里，与选择可靠的接近和撤离路径，是两个问题。

rows.instruction: Arrange the numbers from left to right to form the largest possible number, and place them on the pad.
rows.title: 看起来完成，还要再检查
rows.analysis: 物体大致就位但仿真尚未结束，策略再次检查并调整。这是可见的反馈驱动行为，不是对模型内部思维过程的直接观测。

rows.instruction: Put wooden_toy objects into the left basket, car objects into the middle basket, and watch objects into the right basket, then reset the robot arm.
Put car objects into the left basket, watch objects into the middle basket, and wooden_toy objects into the right basket, then reset the robot arm.
rows.title: 把动作重新对准任务目标
rows.analysis: 这段按语言分类的标注展示了对目标选择的修正。它提供行为证据，但不能单独证明对任意视觉变化都鲁棒。

references.label: 模型说明
references.title: GPT-6 Astra Model
references.author: OpenAI
references.summary: 公开模型文档确认模型标识及图像输入能力。本文实际配置为 gpt-6-astra / xhigh；不以官方能力描述替代机器人实测。

references.label: 社区案例索引
references.title: Awesome Astra Embodied AI

references.summary: 用户推荐的社区索引，区分仿真控制、真机控制、调用预训练策略、Real-to-sim 和环境/RL 构建。作为发现原始案例的入口，不把不同演示的结果混成统一基准。

references.label: 机器人实测
references.title: GPT-6 Astra on robotic manipulation
references.author: Robocurve
references.summary: YAM 机械臂实测：方块入碗 19/20 成功，精细拼图插入 2/20。任务、机器人和评分均不同于 RoboDojo，不直接横比百分比。

references.label: 移动操作演示
references.title: In-context learning on mobile manipulation
references.author: Axel / @ax_pey · Innate
references.summary: 作者分享以演示记录为 context 的移动操作。原帖直连读取受限；帖文由公开索引及镜像定位，并核读作者团队关联的开源 PR。属于个例演示，不是多次成功率评测。

references.label: 演示模仿实现
references.title: Imitate a recorded demonstration with GPT-6 Astra · PR #817
references.author: DavidDobas / innate-inc
references.summary: 团队说明了记录帧、机器人状态、实时相机、历史和动作校验如何组成演示模仿循环。所述模型 effort 与控制约束不同于本文，不当作同设置对照。

references.label: 真机接触演示
references.title: GPT-Policy-Eval: One-Shot Video Demonstration → Real-World Robot Execution
references.author: cheng-haha / GPT-Policy-Eval
references.summary: 单次视频示范驱动真机插头插入、揭开遮挡后放置物体等例子。项目明确说明这些是精选单条演示，更广泛评测仍在进行。

references.label: 可编辑场景重建

references.author: Realsee
references.summary: 使用已有扫描模型、点云、全景与 CAD 等参考构建可编辑 Blender 场景，并进行人工核查。不是仅凭一张 RGB 图像恢复完整物理环境。

references.label: Blender 实践
references.title: I Gave GPT-6 Astra Blender for Three Days. Here Is What It Built and What It Cost.
references.author: AI for Mortals
references.summary: 作者记录建筑、工作室和机器人外观三类 Blender 制作过程、人工反馈与局限。这是 3D 内容制作经验，不是机器人控制实验。

reportData.video_note: Debug videos include the task prompt and projected GPT correction directions.

notes: Each task has five final evaluation slots per method; all ten tasks are included.
Astra arms include retained historical results and explicitly authorized retries; initial states are not strictly paired across methods.
Model abandonment counts as failure. No incomplete slots remain.
The last two pure-Astra BlocksInBin retries used 500 decisions instead of 180; simulator horizon and success rules were unchanged.
These are descriptive results for the selected slots, not a uniform-budget, fresh, single-attempt paired benchmark.
All three historical baselines use the same June 2026 evaluation cohort as the existing pi0.5 reference, selecting the first five episodes per task by run, episode, env_id, including failures.
Task names and episode counts match; historical and Astra evaluations are not verified to share identical initial states, task versions or control settings.
Only scores are added for Cosmos3-Nano-Policy and DreamZero; the existing 150-video gallery is unchanged.
